description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wanniyankulama, Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110215
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, and location details) in Wanniyankulama village. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
